items.title: Simon Property Group (SPG) Stock Fair Value Edges Higher After Analyst Target Increases
items.summary: The latest update for Simon Property Group shows a modest lift in fair value estimates, with the internal price target moving from US$224.42 to US$227.95. That shift aligns with recent Street research, where price targets are clustering higher as analysts refine funds from operations and net operating income assumptions, even while views on risk and entry points remain split. Read on to see how these changing targets, and the research behind them, can help you track the evolving analyst story...
